agent_data_note: Use mounted TON FunC/Tact contracts at `dataset_candidate/ton-smart-contract-defects/`. Prefer `contracts/` (on-chain) and `repo/` (GitHub); use `samples/` for precision/FN labeling checks. Shared mount is read-only.
benchmark_rules: Evaluate on real FunC and Tact-originated FunC contracts from the paper corpora (922 + 718 unique in the paper).
Detect (or redefine carefully) the eight defect families: BR, PL, UR, GVR, IFM, UBM, ID, LEP.
Primary metrics: per-defect precision and overall weighted precision on labeled samples; also report defect prevalence counts (RQ1).
Shared mount is read-only. Copy contracts under `project/` before edits or instrumentation.
Paper machine used ~120GB RAM; if sandbox memory is lower, use a disclosed reduced subset.
Do not silently invent contract corpora when the mount is present. Optional `tools/TONScanner` is a baseline binary, not the dataset.
non_goals: Using only a handful of toy FunC snippets as the sole evaluation
Ignoring TON-specific defects (UBM/ID/LEP/…) and only reporting Solidity-style checks
Silently fabricating precision labels when `samples/` is available
